title: Incorrect Product Ranking Heap
business_scenario: Trending products on the homepage are ranked using a priority queue (Binary Max-Heap).
symptoms: Trending products appear in the wrong order; items with lower scores rank above items with higher scores, particularly on tie-breakers.
reproduction_steps: Insert products with close or identical composite scores.
Compare the order against a verified sorting reference.
expected_behavior: Products must strictly follow descending composite score ordering, with deterministic tie-breaking based on product ID.
actual_behavior: Integer truncation and inverted tie-breaker in the heap comparator invert the ranking of items.
root_cause: The heap comparator in products.service.js uses Math.floor truncation on scores and inverts the tie-breaker logic.
acceptance_criteria: The binary heap must extract items in strict monotonic descending order of composite score.
reference_fix: Use a precision float comparison (diff > 0.0001) and deterministic string comparison for tie-breaking in products.service.js.
regression_tests: Heap push and pop operations maintain valid binary max-heap property.
